result.title: EditJudge-Bench: Auditing VLM Image-Edit Judges with Synthetic Ground Truth
result.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations & Datasets Track). 26 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://jenspars.github.io/EditJudge-Bench/
result.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for image-editing benchmarks, yet their reliability is poorly understood. Auditing these judges is difficult because real edited images lack controlled ground truth and entangle the requested changes with model artefacts, unintended side effects, and ambiguous degrees of success. In this paper, we introduce EditJudge-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,382 synthetic before/after image pairs rendered in Blender, with edits parameterised across nine categories derived from real user requests and exact ground truth from known 3D scene parameters. Because every edit is generated by a known intervention on a controlled scene, EditJudge-Bench evaluates VLM judges as binary verifiers of whether an instruction was correctly executed, isolating judge perception from editor quality. Across 25 judge configurations, we find substantial reliability gaps: (a) the widely adopted VIEScore template reaches only 69.0% AUROC with GPT-4o; (b) fine-tuned judges score 51.7-66.3%; spatial edits such as rotation and shape remain challenging; (c) prompt-formatting choices like image-text ordering shift performance by up to 14.1 points. Despite using only synthetic data, judge rankings on EditJudge-Bench correlate strongly with two real-image human-preference benchmarks ($ρ$=0.95 and $ρ$=0.71), indicating that controlled audits surface failure modes relevant to real evaluation.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 EditJudge-Bench：1,382 对由 Blender 渲染的合成前后图像，覆盖九类源自真实用户请求的编辑，并以已知 3D 场景参数提供精确真值，从而把 VLM 判官当作「指令是否被正确执行」的二值验证器来审计，报告 25 种判官配置下的可靠性差距、空间类编辑难点及提示格式带来的性能波动。
AI.relevance_reason: 其受控合成与精确真值的判官协议可用于核查 VLM 是否能依据真实视觉证据判断细粒度变化、而非依赖文本或格式捷径，与视觉证据筛选及验证停止决策的评估可能相关；但不涉及 latent 推理状态生成，联系需进一步核查。
